snippet.title: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth - Physical Editions Trailer (ESRB)
snippet.description:
At iam8bit, we never turn down the chance to celebrate a global icon like Moomintroll. That’s why we’re so pleased to team up with Hyper Games to bring you this impeccably crafted physical edition. This is the Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth (Physical Retail Edition)! 

In addition to the game, you’ll find two kiss cut sticker sheets featuring characters from Winter’s Warmth. Decorate your trapper keeper, your water bottle, or a local lamp post with the whole gang. Plus, you’ll get a digital download code for the game’s soundtrack, perfect for those cozy nights spent with a good friend and a cup of tea. 

Whether you’re returning to Moominvalley or visiting for the very first time, you’re going to find so much to love here. Don’t miss out!
